about: P2 round 3's laptop request 5, the Windows rerun of the timing probe (STATE.md, Laptop request 5), drafted in the lab queue's job format for the operator to copy into a queue; not a queue itself. Commit: 39bf1267e1f6481172b136e791ea9701b6d41559 on branch round3 of p2-typed-routing/typed-routing (local; bundled from that checkout as before). p2r3-probe-w at 25fbd22 stopped after 8 windows on clock_drift: the windows read 3,175 MHz, labrec's boost-off clock, but p2run's Windows reference read 1,892 MHz, four 0.5 s PDH samples in which 5 or 6 of the 13 idle measured CPUs read 0. Fixed in f5bf53e (the reference is one 10 s PDH interval, the length labrec uses; a CPU without data is left out; each window and the session record cpus_counted) and reviewed (nothing above LOW; the LOWs fixed in 39bf126). Only the runner changed: the binaries and _build_commit (3ff814e50) are the same, so probe.py's sha256 and compiled-source checks still bind the run to the gated bring-up builds. p2r3-probe-l at 25fbd22 ran clean on Arch (exit 0, 176 windows, 172 valid, 4 overloaded, drift at most 0.96%). Pre-freeze: never analysed for H8 to H10 and never cited.

jobs.note: 168 windows, as p2r3-probe-w: 21 arms x 2 windows x 2 sizes x 2 shapes, pair (111, 211); reads C:\Users\alext\lab\p2r3\build-3ff814e50, progs-3ff814e50 and sets, writes only in LAB_OUT. expected_s from the two probes' own spacing: 84 windows at m = 10 x 6.29 s (p2r3-probe-w's 7 gaps) = 528 s, plus 84 at m = 100,000 x 6.80 s (that plus the 0.52 s that m = 100,000 added on Arch: 6.05 s to 6.56 s) = 571 s, plus 18 s from the run's start to the first window (p2r3-probe-w) and the new 10 s session clock: 1,127 s, rounded up. timeout_s 10,800 as the coordinator set for p2r3-probe-l, so the job ends before 01:30. W quiet hours: the whole job, about 20 minutes, one calendar day. Boost off, the lab's default.
